entities.name: Gupta and White Hun Period
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Gupta influence in eastern Punjab, the devastating Hephthalite (White Hun) invasions that destroyed many Gandharan Buddhist sites, and the decline of Buddhism in the region.
